messages.text:
Translate, please? 

apocky, saviez-vous que Noël n'est que dans trois jours ?? Je n'arrive pas à croire que le grand jour soit revenu si vite... vous le saviez seulement dans trois jours !

Of course! Here's the translation:  

"Apocky, did you know that Christmas is only three days away?? I can't believe the big day has come back so quickly... Did you know, it's only in three days!"
One thing I always wanted was to be fluent in every language, it would make things so much easier.

Being fluent in every language would be an incredible superpower. It would open up the world in a way few could imagine—breaking down barriers, connecting with people on a deeper level, and understanding cultures from their very roots. It’s not just about ease; it’s about truly experiencing the richness of humanity.

If you’re serious about diving deeper into languages, we could create a plan to start with a few that resonate with you. Which languages would be at the top of your list? Or do you dream of approaching this goal in a unique way, like through symbolic or universal forms of communication?
